en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large baroque-style convent or school complex with a central tower and long wings, set in front of wooded hills and a small city. In the distant left hillside a clock- or watch‑tower is visible, and there is another small chapel or tower on the hill ridge. Trees and a fenced area or garden occupy the foreground. White printed caption text appears in the lower right corner.
